alerts.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 14 at 10:03PM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 24 to 30 possible. Lower
valleys may drop to 20.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

alerts.title: Chain Law Code 18
alerts.description: Between Electra Lake Road and Little Molas Lake (5 to 21 miles south of the Silverton area) from Mile Point 48 to Mile Point 64. Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMV) must have chains or approved alternative traction devices. Slower speeds are advised.

alerts.title: Traction Law Code 15
alerts.description: Between Electra Lake Road and Little Molas Lake (5 to 21 miles south of the Silverton area) from Mile Point 48 to Mile Point 64. Passenger vehicles that are all-wheel drive (AWD) or four-wheel drive (4WD) must have winter (Mountain Snowflake icon) or mud and snow (M+S or M/S) or manufacturer rated all-weather tires with adequate tread depth of at least 3/16 of an inch. Two-wheel drive (2WD) vehicles are required to have chains or an approved traction device. Slower speeds are advised.

alerts.title: Southwest CO Culvert Repairs-148804
alerts.description: Between County Road 322 and BIA 315 (near Southern Ute) at Mile Point 3.2. Culvert maintenance operations. There is a width limit in effect. Width limit 10'0". Until October 20, 2026 at about 7:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 8, 7:00PM - October 20, 7:00AM Comment: Expect alternating traffic and delays of up to 15 minutes 24/7 managed by a portable traffic signal. A 10 ' width restriction is in place. From October 20 to 24 this road will be closed. Alternate routes are advised.

alerts.title: Road Construction-149129
alerts.description: Between CO 3 and Kirk Lane (1 mile east of the Durango area) from Mile Point 86 to Mile Point 92. Right lane closed due to road construction. Starting October 15, 2026 at 7:00PM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 7:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 15, 7:00PM - October 16, 7:00AM Comment: Various eastbound and westbound single lane closures, reduced speed to 40 mph and up to 15-minute delays. For more information email: resurfacingproject@gmail.com.

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147594
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 17, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 17, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 17, 7:00AM - October 17, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
